## Route the review

Add a Save button to the settings dialog that writes the settings file.

## Acceptance criteria

0. The settings dialog shows a Save button -- check: `npm test -- settings`
1. Clicking Save writes settings.json -- check: `npm test -- save`

## Changed files

- src/settings.ts
- src/dialog.tsx

Decide which review areas this change can break. Depth follows what a change can break, not its size: a large mechanical rename inside one module can break little, while a one-line change to a shared contract can break a great deal. Set an area true only when this change can break something in it.

- seams: callers, consumers or contracts outside the diff that the change touches.
- code: the logic it changes, against the criteria.
- tests: whether the checks prove the criteria.
- errors: failure, timeout and empty-input paths.
- docs: documentation and user-facing text.

You may read files in the working directory but change nothing. Read the repository where the file list is not enough.

## Report format

Reply with:

```sushi-route
{"lenses":{"seams":true|false,"code":true|false,"tests":true|false,"errors":true|false,"docs":true|false},"reason":"<one sentence>"}
```
